terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: Gateway-only preview on http://localhost:8080. It can manage dynamic users and workspaces, but screen streaming and the one persistent Chromium profile still require the Docker Compose desktop service.
terminals.command: mkdir -p /workspace/data-panel /workspace/data-transfer && STATE_FILE=/workspace/data-panel/state.json SESSIONS_FILE=/workspace/data-panel/sessions.json TRANSFER_STATE_FILE=/workspace/data-panel/transfers.json TRANSFER_ROOT=/workspace/data-transfer PROFILE_AUTO_DETECT=false PORT=8080 MAINTENANCE_LISTEN_PORT=8081 node gateway/server.mjs
